description: This file defines a TypeScript module for managing the cleanup process of failed 'spawn' sessions within an OpenClaw control plane. It includes a type definition for closing handles, and an asynchronous function `cleanupFailedAcpSpawn` that orchestrates runtime cleanup, session management, unbinding, and optional deletion of session data.

classes.name: AcpSpawnRuntimeCloseHandle
classes.description: Type representing the handle for closing a runtime session, containing methods to close the runtime and associated session information.

methods.name: export async function cleanupFailedAcpSpawn(params: { cleanupFailedAcpSpawn
methods.description: Asynchronous function to clean up resources and state after a failed spawn attempt, including runtime closure, session management, unbinding, and optional session deletion.
